question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cruise
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **"Voyage".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cruise**: (क्रूज) - A trip on a ship or boat taken for pleasure or as a vacation and usually calling in at several places.

 
 
• **Example**: We went on a cruise to the Caribbean for our anniversary.
 
 
 
• **Voyage**: (यात्रा) - A long journey involving travel by sea or in space.
 
 
• **Example**: The Titanic's maiden voyage ended in tragedy.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Voyage".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bounce**: (उछाल) - Come back up after hitting a hard surface or object.

 
 
• **Example**: The ball bounced off the wall.
 
 
 
• **Fall**: (गिरना) - Move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.
 
 
• **Example**: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
 
 
 
• **Distance**: (दूरी) - An amount of space between two things or people.
 
 
• **Example**: The distance from my home to school is 3 kilometers.
